description: Search global news articles by keyword (e.g., "climate change", "AI regulation"). Returns title, description, content snippet, source, and publication date. Supports language, country and a from/to publication window. Results per request are capped by the GNews plan behind the key (free plan: 10, paid: 25/50/100); the response reports requested, returned and the shortfall reason, and states original_query and applied_query. Free plan history is the last 30 days: a window older than that returns total_articles above 0 with no articles, and empty_reason then says before_free_window rather than no_match.

from.description: Only articles published at or after this time. ISO 8601 date or datetime (e.g. "2026-09-16" or "2026-09-16T00:00:00Z"); a bare date means 00:00:00Z. GNews free plan history is the last 30 days, paid plans since 2020

max.description: Max articles to return (1-100, default 10). GNews caps this by plan (free 10); see requested/returned in the response

to.description: Only articles published at or before this time. ISO 8601 date or datetime; a bare date means 23:59:59Z. On the free plan GNews requires this to be at least 12 hours ago

name: gnews_search_news

articles.description: List of news articles matching the search

source_url.description: Homepage URL of the news source

articles_outside_window.description: Returned articles dated outside the window

count_explanation.description: Present when returned < requested: why (GNews plan cap or too few matches)

empty_explanation.description: Plain-words account of why a matched total came back with no articles

empty_reason.description: Present when GNews matched articles but delivered none: before_free_window (from is older than the free plan history of 30 days) or filtered_out. Never no_match while total_articles is above 0

original_query.description: Query as the caller sent it

plan_cap_observed.description: Per-request cap observed on the GNews plan behind the key

query_rewritten.description: True when applied_query differs from original_query

returned.description: Number of articles returned in this response

total_articles.description: Total number of articles matching the search query

window_applied.description: The from/to window sent upstream (ISO 8601 UTC), null for an open end

window_check.description: Present when articles fall outside the window

window_history.description: Plan-history caveat when from is over 30 days ago

title: Gnews Search News
